final.coverage: Real browser/BFF/API/PostgreSQL/SMTP confirmation and reload; API/web restart persistence; actual API 503 with no effect; SMTP outage and recovery; privacy/log and metrics checks; unchanged protected hashes/PIDs and both release pointers; native mail start limit preserved. Six generated unique confirmation tokens were checked for leakage.

smoke_chronology.history: The initial FAILED harness receipts remain preserved; the final continuation records resolved harness limits and the combined 80 successful assertions. No passed scenario was rerun by this reviewer.

v04_04_dependency_boundary.basis: AL-V04-04 expects the site and lead path to work without the existing Octoport API/database and for the current site/lab to remain unchanged. The source architecture checker rejects legacy product dependencies and selected outbound client/executor imports; a read-only source scan found no requests/httpx/urllib.request/subprocess imports in the platform, web, or identity implementation. The public BFF fixes its upstream to loopback, allows only three own API paths, rejects redirects, and stage settings point only to the own platform API and private loopback SMTP. The actual HTTPS/BFF/API/PostgreSQL/SMTP lead path succeeded, and protected current/lab files and services matched preflight.

network_layer_egress.conclusion: No systemd IP-address denial or private network namespace is configured for these units. No packet-level or host-firewall denial test was run, and this report does not claim one. The AL-V04-04 dependency-independence outcome is accepted at code/configuration level; network-layer egress blocking remains unproven and was not an explicit tested action in the cited scenario.
